name: MoonWitness Mizan Evidence Provenance and Analytical Responsibility Extension

ari_calibration.label: Analytical Responsibility Index
ari_calibration.meaning: A versioned analytical responsibility index for comparing event responsibility factors inside MoonWitness. It is not a moral worth score, salvation score, holiness score, legal verdict, or final divine judgment.

invariants_add.rule: TH remains a separate structural responsibility weight and must not be replaced by ARI
ARI is analytical and must never be presented as final moral or divine judgment
Unknown analytical factors prevent ARI calculation rather than being silently guessed
An ARI may be calculated but must be marked provisional when evidence bindings are insufficient
Every factor evidence binding must resolve to an existing evidence id
Evidence strength and provenance completeness are reported separately
Absence of evidence must remain explicit and must not be converted into fabricated certainty
